title: Generation counts return to the front page
summary:
Front-page counters returned while four community projects joined the creative directory.

Generation count badges are back on the image and text feeds, with corrected displayed rates. Feed-switch button labels also stay put instead of being automatically rephrased.

The Creative Projects directory added Imagine Draw AI for prompt-based images and Aimpress for images with optional styles, effects, and aspect ratios. Aimpress also publishes images to a searchable public archive.

Two more projects joined the directory: Evolve AI combines speech, code, and image generation, while What is this? identifies objects in uploaded photos.
